requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:7-9 removes the closing `});` of the `/` route, so the routes file does not parse and no route works. app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:28 and Register.php:33 declare `submit(): void` but `return redirect()->route('home')` (compile-time fatal). app/Models/User.php:5,15 `implements` the trait `Illuminate\Auth\MustVerifyEmail` instead of the contract (fatal). Register.php:11 imports non-existent `Illuminate\Auth\Auth`. ResetPasswordController.php:15 and VerificationController.php:13 type-hint non-existent `Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Http\RedirectResponse`. Password::defaults() is called on the broker facade (AppServiceProvider.php:31, Register.php:28, ResetPasswordController.php:24), so the min 8/letters/mixed case/numbers rule is never configured. Also missing: .env.example and phpunit.xml locale pins, redirect()->intended in Login, strict e-mail validation (`'email'` only), and a check of the existing views for hardcoded links. lang/pt_BR/ui.php:11 says 'Esqueceu sua senha?' where the task needs 'Esqueceu a senha?'.

conventions.evidence: Livewire components use `protected function rules()` instead of the project's `#[Validate]` pattern (Login.php:20, Register.php:24). Logout and forgot-password logic are route closures (routes/web.php:21-27, 39-43) although the contract places logout and password reset in controllers. The layout loads Bulma 0.9.3 from a CDN (components/layouts/auth.blade.php:7) instead of the app's build. Controllers do not extend the base Controller. There is no CHANGELOG or docs update. Blade components, `{{ }}` escaping and named routes in the new views are used correctly.

security.evidence: Rate limiting is present in Login.php:36-45 (lowercased e-mail + IP) and Register.php:36-41. The verification link compares the route user's e-mail to the authenticated user (VerificationController.php:20) and returns 403 on a mismatch. Reset rotates remember_token (ResetPasswordController.php:32). Forgot-password always flashes passwords.sent (web.php:42). Gaps: the password-strength defaults are never configured, so the 'default rule' imposes nothing; e-mail is not validated strictly; the verification hash is not checked against the user. The code also does not run, so none of these protections take effect.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/AuthTest.php covers login success/failure, logout, forgot-password with no enumeration, throttle 429, reset plus remember_token rotation, register validation/confirmed/rate limit, verification tamper (403) and resend no-op. However, LocalizationTest.php:35 uses `Livewire::test` without importing Livewire, and LocalizationTest.php:20 expects 'Esqueceu a senha?', which the translation does not contain, so these tests fail. The test at line 9 needs .env.example changes that are not in the diff. The login throttle (auth.throttle) and the intended redirect are not tested. Given the fatal errors, the suite cannot be green.

simplicity.evidence: The overall structure is small and direct, with plain closures and two thin controllers. There is some duplication: the same login/register link block is repeated across the auth views. Register.php:51 uses the FQCN `\Illuminate\Auth\Events\Registered` although that class is already imported at line 13. `$validated` is unused in Login.php:30 and Register.php:42.

readability.evidence: Commented-out imports are left in several files (ResetPasswordController.php:10-11, VerificationController.php:6-12, Login.php:8-9,12, Register.php:10,14). Imports are unused (`Request`, `Password` in routes/web.php:5-6). There are stray blank lines in routes/web.php and an `<!-- Home Page -->` HTML comment in home.blade.php:1. AuthTest.php:169-171 has a misleading comment about `ensureIsNotRateLimited` and the order of hit().

scope.evidence: Almost every file serves the auth task. The only unrelated edit is the accidental breakage of the existing `/` route in routes/web.php:7-9, plus the CDN Bulma layout, which sidesteps the project's asset build.

issues.explanation: The closing `});` of the `/` route was deleted, so the routes file is a PHP parse error and the whole application fails to boot.
`submit(): void` returns a redirect, which PHP rejects at compile time with a fatal error.
`Illuminate\Auth\MustVerifyEmail` is a trait, and `implements` on a trait is a fatal error; the task needs the `Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\MustVerifyEmail` interface.
It imports the non-existent class `Illuminate\Auth\Auth` instead of the `Auth` facade, so `Auth::login()` fails.
The return type `Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Http\RedirectResponse` does not exist, so every return throws a TypeError.
`Password::defaults()` is called on the password-broker facade instead of `Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password`, and no min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers() rule is ever configured.
APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE are not set in .env.example and the phpunit.xml locale pins are missing, so the app does not default to pt_BR.
`Livewire::test` is used without importing `Livewire\Livewire`, so the test errors.
The translation is 'Esqueceu sua senha?', but the task (and the shipped test) requires 'Esqueceu a senha?'.
E-mail is validated only with `email` (not strict), and success uses `redirect()->route('home')` instead of the required intended redirect.
The flash uses the non-existent key `verification.email_sent`, so the raw key is shown to users.
The task requires the existing views to be free of hardcoded href/action paths, but the diff does not touch or verify them.
Validation uses `rules()` instead of the project's `#[Validate]` attribute pattern.
Logout and forgot-password logic live in route closures, while the contract asks for controllers under app/Http/Controllers.
The layout loads Bulma 0.9.3 from a CDN instead of the project's asset build.
The docs and changelog are not updated, although the conventions require it.
Commented-out and unused imports are left in the code.
The FQCN `\Illuminate\Auth\Events\Registered` is used although `Registered` is already imported.

review.summary: The change adds Livewire login/register, password reset, e-mail verification, pt_BR/en UI translations and a fairly thorough feature-test suite. It cannot run: routes/web.php has a syntax error, both Livewire `submit(): void` methods return values, User implements a trait, and non-existent classes are imported or used as return types. The password default rule is never configured, and the locale setup in .env.example and phpunit.xml is missing, so the PR must be rejected.
